seed_provenance: cmd/finaleval rnd fixed LCG fixture; HE/authentication randomness not seeded

timing_boundary.definition: B-fair-v3 common fresh-session public-right matmul boundary: t0 immediately before HE parameter/context construction; end after the last verify/decode and n x n matrix restoration. Fixture, plaintext reference and layout computation precede t0; serialization, correctness comparison, counts and logging follow t_end.
timing_boundary.derived: setup_ns=S1+S2+S3, prep_ns=S4, client_online_ns=S5+S7+S8+S9, server_ns=S6 (measured stages only; N/A adds nothing; inter-stage gaps excluded, so setup+prep+client_online+server+gap = E2E)
timing_boundary.direct: direct_computation_ns: one matrix.Mul before t0, outside S1..S9
timing_boundary.e2e_from_keygen: t_end - S2.begin (reference for B-2 total_time_ns definition only)
timing_boundary.unit: ns (converted from raw QPC ticks by integer quotient/remainder)

workload_definition.expression: C_j = A*B_j mod 65537, j=0..k-1; one encrypted A, distinct public B_j

direct_computation_method: 4 calls of matrix.Mul(field 65537), one per program (total reported); one call, no repetition; QPC before t0, outside S1..S9; same result is the correctness reference
error_magnitude_definition: max over programs of max centered modular absolute difference

memory.scope: read after t_end, outside the timeline; process peak is cumulative over the process

operation_count_scope: completed bfvpack evaluator API calls summed over all programs (server_evaluation only)
